deepdive.sec: Construction & Infrastructure / Government-Focused Building & Civil Works

bull_bear.body: IPO proceeds fully deployed in working capital (EMD, materials, billing cycles); no FPO planned for next 12 months; no dividends or buybacks mentioned; focus on order book growth and execution
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Intense competition driving down bid prices; delayed government payments (minor, max 25 days); over-reliance on top 5 customers (70-73% revenue); geographic concentration in North India
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, focused on execution and shareholder returns; dismissive of private clients due to cash flow risks; proud of NBCC/Railways relationships; optimistic on FY26 results and pipeline
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Despite 221% revenue growth, EBITDA margin remains extremely low (~1.5%) — suggests revenue growth is volume-driven, not margin-accretive; IPO funds enabled bidding capacity, not profitability
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: 75% revenue from multi-storey buildings (includes LT/HT, plumbing); 25% from structural steel works; no revenue from private builders beyond 25%; projects avg 18-month cycle
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Intense competition and low bid prices | Small regional contractors | loser | High | NACDAC's IPO-funded bidding capacity and scale make it hard for smaller players to compete for govt tenders |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

latest_quarter.body: EBITDA margin ~1.5% (industry avg 7%); improving via machinery efficiency and faster execution (16mo vs 18mo contract); no material cost inflation cited; margins constrained by competitive bidding
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: revenue growth: 65-70Cr for FY26 (vs 50Cr last year); margin: stable to slightly improve via machinery upgrades; order inflow: targeting 150Cr under evaluation; capex/commissioning: 1-1.5Cr on machinery in next 12 months
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: 90-95Cr (75-76% government, 24-25% private); major contributors: NBCC multi-storey judiciary building, 2L sq.ft warehouse
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Expanding geographically into Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Jaipur, Lucknow; targeting new govt departments (Defence, ITBP, MES); bidding projects up to 37Cr
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Revenue surged 221% YoY in H1FY26 due to IPO fund deployment enabling larger bids and faster execution, with EBITDA and PAT margins improving significantly; what matters is the 95Cr order book and 150Cr pipeline under evaluation, positioning the company for sustained growth without new fundraising.
